method: All500 lines read; unchanged base64 helper extracted and verified against seven standard fixed vectors in a synthetic harness. No screen capture or upload executed.
findings: Module implements external Google Lens upload, not local OCR or content deduplication. Lasso points determine an axis-aligned rectangle; no polygon mask is applied to the crop. This matters when describing selected-region behavior.

Temporary HTML name depends only on process id. Repeated invocation in same process shares the same file; older60second cleanup can delete a later invocation file. Static overlap mechanism, no browser/capture concurrency run.

Captured PNG is base64 embedded in temporary HTML, opened by ShellExecute; deletion is delayed best effort and open result ignored. Browser upload completion is not tracked. No user screen or file was captured or transmitted.

capture_screen and crop_bitmap ignore BitBlt results and can return a bitmap despite copy failure; multiple rendering/crop resource creations are not checked before use. Partial/failing Windows API paths unqualified.

bitmap_to_rgba uses unchecked u32 width*height*4 allocation arithmetic and accepts any nonzero GetDIBits scanline count rather than verifying full height. Dimensions originate from screen-crop bitmap in this module; no arbitrary-file reachability claimed.
Pixel conversion swaps blue/red but does not explicitly set alpha opaque for32bit BI_RGB. Actual alpha bytes and resulting PNG transparency need Windows fixtures; no visual result qualified.

WM_DESTROY clears userdata before freeing owned data and bitmap, explicitly protecting later messages. Successful capture/DC cleanup paths restore selected objects and release resources; error coverage is not inferred from those normal paths.
Overlay point count has a movement threshold but no hard count cap; full-screen compatible bitmaps are created per paint. No performance measurement or optimization acceptance.

Seven standard base64 vectors covering zero input and all padding lengths passed. This qualifies encoding helper only, not PNG fidelity, browser File/DataTransfer support, Lens availability or successful submission.

executed_controls.scope: Synthetic known-answer vectors against unchanged extracted original helper; upstream module has no test block.

limits: Windows overlay/bitmap/browser/network integration unrun; no local production changes.
